comment: Netflix App — STEPS MODE goal file.
STEPS MODE: search and verify a title in Netflix.
These steps are worded to help StepIntentParser, Element Registry, and Set-of-Mark grounding resolve the correct visual target.
goal: Search for title 'Bloons TDSix' in Netflix App and verify search results
steps: Wait 5 seconds for the choose your profile screen to load completely
Wait 5 seconds for the Netflix home screen to load completely
Tap the 'Search' icon from the bottom navigation menu
Wait 2 seconds for the search input field to become visible
Type 'Bloons TDSix' in the search input field
Wait for 2 seconds to search results to populate
Verify that a search result containing the title 'Bloons TDSix' is displayed
